translation: Erythrina bark (海桐皮), iron-money tou gu cao (鐵錢透骨草), bright pure frankincense (明淨乳香), myrrh (沒藥, each two qian), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine, one qian five fen), Sichuan pepper (川椒, three qian), chuanxiong (川芎, one qian), safflower (紅花, one qian), clematis (威靈仙), angelica dahurica (白芷), licorice (甘草), saposhnikovia (防風, each eight fen). Grind all together into a coarse powder, put in a white cloth bag, tie the mouth, decoct into a decoction, and fumigate and wash the affected area. <ins>Bi Bo San (蓽茇散)</ins> Long pepper (蓽茇), galangal (良薑), asarum (細辛, each one qian). Boil in three cups of water down to one cup, rinse the mouth. <ins>Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹)</ins> (see the two mountain-corner injuries)
